bugs_found: compound_interest silently truncates fractional years and compounds_per_year via int(), changing financial results without error
compound_interest allows negative principal, enabling nonsensical negative accruals unless explicitly intended
transfer does not coerce/validate amount as Decimal, so float/string/NaN inputs can cause TypeError, inconsistent comparisons, or invalid balances
transfer is non-atomic: if crediting account_to fails after debiting account_from, balances become inconsistent
apply_fee returns abs(a - fee), so a fee greater than amount becomes a positive payout-like result instead of rejecting or flooring at zero
fx_convert does not validate exchange rate positivity/finite value, allowing zero/negative/NaN/Infinity rates to produce invalid converted money
all money-returning functions omit currency-scale quantization/rounding, risking precision/settlement mismatches
